+@tilelang.jit(

+        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
+        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,

+def _unpack_split_experts_kernel(
+    hidden,
+    num_experts,
+    total_padded_tokens,
+    total_valid_tokens,
+    split_m,
+    row_base,
+):
+    block_n = 256
+    threads = 256
+
+    @T.prim_func
+    def kernel(
+        split_output: T.Tensor((num_experts, split_m, hidden), T.float16),
+        routed_expert_weights: T.Tensor((total_valid_tokens,), T.float32),
+        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
+        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
+        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
+        out: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
+    ):
+        with T.Kernel(
+            num_experts,
+            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_n),
+            threads=threads,
+        ) as (expert_id, bn):
+            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
+            raw_start = group_offsets[expert_id]
+            padded_start = group_padded_offsets[expert_id]
+            for i, j in T.Parallel(split_m, block_n):
+                global_i = row_base + i
+                if global_i < group_size:
+                    out[padded_start + global_i, bn * block_n + j] = (
+                        split_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
+                        * routed_expert_weights[raw_start + global_i]
+                    )
+
+    return kernel
+

+def _unpack_split_experts_kernel(
+    hidden,
+    num_experts,
+    total_padded_tokens,
+    total_valid_tokens,
+    split_m,
+    row_base,
+):
+    block_n = 256
+    threads = 256
+
+    @T.prim_func
+    def kernel(
+        split_output: T.Tensor((num_experts, split_m, hidden), T.float16),
+        routed_expert_weights: T.Tensor((total_valid_tokens,), T.float32),
+        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
+        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
+        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
+        out: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
+    ):
+        with T.Kernel(
+            num_experts,
+            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_n),
+            threads=threads,
+        ) as (expert_id, bn):
+            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
+            raw_start = group_offsets[expert_id]
+            padded_start = group_padded_offsets[expert_id]
+            for i, j in T.Parallel(split_m, block_n):
+                global_i = row_base + i
+                if global_i < group_size:
+                    out[padded_start + global_i, bn * block_n + j] = (
+                        split_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
+                        * routed_expert_weights[raw_start + global_i]
+                    )
+
+    return kernel

@@ -96,6 +96,51 @@ def _unpack_experts_kernel(
     return kernel
 
 
+
+@tilelang.jit(
+    pass_configs={
+        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
+        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
+    }
+)
+def _unpack_split_experts_kernel(
+    hidden,
+    num_experts,
+    total_padded_tokens,
+    total_valid_tokens,
+    split_m,
+    row_base,
+):
+    block_n = 256
+    threads = 256
+
+    @T.prim_func
+    def kernel(
+        split_output: T.Tensor((num_experts, split_m, hidden), T.float16),
+        routed_expert_weights: T.Tensor((total_valid_tokens,), T.float32),
+        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
+        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
+        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
+        out: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
+    ):
+        with T.Kernel(
+            num_experts,
+            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_n),
+            threads=threads,
+        ) as (expert_id, bn):
+            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
+            raw_start = group_offsets[expert_id]
+            padded_start = group_padded_offsets[expert_id]
+            for i, j in T.Parallel(split_m, block_n):
+                global_i = row_base + i
+                if global_i < group_size:
+                    out[padded_start + global_i, bn * block_n + j] = (
+                        split_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
+                        * routed_expert_weights[raw_start + global_i]
+                    )
+
+    return kernel
+

import torch
import tilelang
import tilelang.language as T


_KERNEL_CACHE = {}
_WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY = None
_WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE = None
_WEIGHT_CACHE = {}
_EXPERT_BLOCK_M = 192


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _pack_experts_kernel(
    hidden,
    num_experts,
    total_padded_tokens,
    expert_block_m,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    packed_shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, hidden)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        stacked_expert_tokens: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        packed_input: T.Tensor(packed_shape, T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
            padded_start = group_padded_offsets[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    packed_input[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        stacked_expert_tokens[padded_start + i, bn * block_n + j]
                    )

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,

def _unpack_experts_kernel(
    hidden,
    num_experts,
    total_padded_tokens,
    total_valid_tokens,
    expert_block_m,
    expert_start,
    expert_chunk,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    packed_shape = (expert_chunk, expert_block_m, hidden)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        packed_output: T.Tensor(packed_shape, T.float16),
        routed_expert_weights: T.Tensor((total_valid_tokens,), T.float32),
        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        out: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            expert_chunk,
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (local_expert_id, bn):
            expert_id = expert_start + local_expert_id
            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
            raw_start = group_offsets[expert_id]
            padded_start = group_padded_offsets[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    out[padded_start + i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        packed_output[local_expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                        * routed_expert_weights[raw_start + i]
                    )

    return kernel

def _bucket_compact_kernel(
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    expert_block_m,
    bucket_m,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        activation: T.Tensor(
            (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate), T.float16
        ),
        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
        bucket_activation: T.Tensor(
            (num_experts, bucket_m, intermediate), T.float16
        ),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(bucket_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    bucket_activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    )
                else:
                    bucket_activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = T.float16(0)

    return kernel

@tilelang.jit(

def _swiglu_kernel(
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    expert_block_m,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_output: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
        up_output: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        activation: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            group_size = group_offsets[expert_id + 1] - group_offsets[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    gate = gate_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        gate
                        * T.sigmoid(gate)
                        * up_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    )

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _combine_fc1_weights_kernel(
    hidden,
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
):
    block_i = 64
    block_h = 256
    threads = 256

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate, hidden), T.float16),
        up_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate, hidden), T.float16),
        combined_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate * 2, hidden), T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate * 2, block_i),
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_h),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bi, bh):
            for i, j in T.Parallel(block_i, block_h):
                row = bi * block_i + i
                col = bh * block_h + j
                if row < intermediate:
                    combined_w[expert_id, row, col] = gate_w[expert_id, row, col]
                else:
                    combined_w[expert_id, row, col] = up_w[
                        expert_id, row - intermediate, col
                    ]

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _combined_swiglu_kernel(
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    expert_block_m,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    combined_shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate * 2)
    activation_shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_up_output: T.Tensor(combined_shape, T.float16),
        activation: T.Tensor(activation_shape, T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                gate = gate_up_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                    gate
                    * T.sigmoid(gate)
                    * gate_up_output[
                        expert_id,
                        i,
                        intermediate + bn * block_n + j,
                    ]
                )

    return kernel


def _get_kernels(
    hidden,
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    total_padded_tokens,
    total_valid_tokens,
    expert_block_m,
):
    key = (
        int(hidden),
        int(intermediate),
        int(num_experts),
        int(total_padded_tokens),
        int(total_valid_tokens),
        int(expert_block_m),
    )
    kernels = _KERNEL_CACHE.get(key)
    if kernels is None:
        expert_chunk = 32 if num_experts == 32 else 16
        fuse_fc1 = False
        kernels = (
            _pack_experts_kernel(
                hidden,
                num_experts,
                total_padded_tokens,
                expert_block_m,
            ),
            _swiglu_kernel(
                intermediate,
                num_experts,
                expert_block_m,
            ),
            (
                _combine_fc1_weights_kernel(hidden, intermediate, num_experts)
                if fuse_fc1
                else None
            ),
            (
                _combined_swiglu_kernel(
                    intermediate,
                    num_experts,
                    expert_block_m,
                )
                if fuse_fc1
                else None
            ),
            (
                _bucket_compact_kernel(
                    intermediate,
                    num_experts,
                    expert_block_m,
                    128,
                )
                if num_experts == 32
                else None
            ),
            (
                _bucket_unpack_kernel(
                    hidden,
                    num_experts,
                    total_padded_tokens,
                    total_valid_tokens,
                    128,
                )
                if num_experts == 32
                else None
            ),
            tuple(
                _unpack_experts_kernel(
                    hidden,
                    num_experts,
                    total_padded_tokens,
                    total_valid_tokens,
                    expert_block_m,
                    expert_start,
                    min(expert_chunk, num_experts - expert_start),
                )
                for expert_start in range(0, num_experts, expert_chunk)
            ),
        )
        _KERNEL_CACHE[key] = kernels
    return kernels


def _get_workspace(
    stacked_expert_tokens,
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    expert_block_m,
):
    global _WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY, _WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE
    hidden = int(stacked_expert_tokens.shape[1])
    key = (
        int(stacked_expert_tokens.device.index or 0),
        int(num_experts),
        hidden,
        int(intermediate),
        int(expert_block_m),
        str(stacked_expert_tokens.dtype),
    )
    if _WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY != key:
        _WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY = None
        _WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE = None
        packed_input = torch.empty(
            (num_experts, expert_block_m, hidden),
            device=stacked_expert_tokens.device,
            dtype=stacked_expert_tokens.dtype,
        )
        activation = (
            torch.empty(
                (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate),
                device=stacked_expert_tokens.device,
                dtype=stacked_expert_tokens.dtype,
            )
            if False
            else None
        )
        _WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY = key
        _WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE = (packed_input, activation)
    return _WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE


def _get_combined_fc1_weight(gate_w, up_w, combine_weights):
    key = (
        int(gate_w.device.index or 0),
        int(gate_w.shape[0]),
        int(gate_w.shape[1]),
        int(gate_w.shape[2]),
        str(gate_w.dtype),
    )
    cached = _WEIGHT_CACHE.get(key)
    if cached is None or cached[0] is not gate_w or cached[1] is not up_w:
        combined_w = torch.empty(
            (gate_w.shape[0], gate_w.shape[1] * 2, gate_w.shape[2]),
            device=gate_w.device,
            dtype=gate_w.dtype,
        )
        combine_weights(gate_w, up_w, combined_w)
        cached = (gate_w, up_w, combined_w)
        _WEIGHT_CACHE[key] = cached
    return cached[2]


def run_kernel(
    stacked_expert_tokens,
    gate_w,
    up_w,
    down_w,
    routed_expert_weights,
    group_sizes,
    group_offsets,
    group_padded_offsets,
    group_idx_for_bx,
    out,
):
    hidden = int(stacked_expert_tokens.shape[1])
    intermediate = int(gate_w.shape[1])
    num_experts = int(gate_w.shape[0])
    total_padded_tokens = int(stacked_expert_tokens.shape[0])
    total_valid_tokens = int(routed_expert_weights.shape[0])

    expert_block_m = _EXPERT_BLOCK_M

    (
        pack,
        swiglu,
        combine_weights,
        combined_swiglu,
        bucket_compact,
        bucket_unpack,
        unpack_chunks,
    ) = _get_kernels(
        hidden,
        intermediate,
        num_experts,
        total_padded_tokens,
        total_valid_tokens,
        expert_block_m,
    )
    packed_input, activation = _get_workspace(
        stacked_expert_tokens,
        intermediate,
        num_experts,
        expert_block_m,
    )

    pack(
        stacked_expert_tokens,
        group_sizes,
        group_padded_offsets,
        packed_input,
    )
    gate_output = packed_input @ gate_w.transpose(1, 2)
    up_output = packed_input @ up_w.transpose(1, 2)
    swiglu(gate_output, up_output, group_offsets, gate_output)
    del up_output
    activation = gate_output
    if bucket_compact is not None:
        bucket_activation = torch.empty(
            (num_experts, 128, intermediate),
            device=activation.device,
            dtype=activation.dtype,
        )
        bucket_compact(activation, group_sizes, bucket_activation)
        bucket_output = bucket_activation @ down_w.transpose(1, 2)
        del bucket_activation
        bucket_unpack(
            bucket_output,
            routed_expert_weights,
            group_sizes,
            group_offsets,
            group_padded_offsets,
            out,
        )
        del bucket_output
    else:
        expert_chunk = 32 if num_experts == 32 else 16
        for chunk_id, expert_start in enumerate(range(0, num_experts, expert_chunk)):
            expert_end = min(expert_start + expert_chunk, num_experts)
            packed_output = (
                activation[expert_start:expert_end]
                @ down_w[expert_start:expert_end].transpose(1, 2)
            )
            unpack_chunks[chunk_id](
                packed_output,
                routed_expert_weights,
                group_sizes,
                group_offsets,
                group_padded_offsets,
                out,
            )
            del packed_output

    shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_output: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
        up_output: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        activation: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            group_size = group_offsets[expert_id + 1] - group_offsets[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    gate = gate_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        gate
                        * T.sigmoid(gate)
                        * up_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    )

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _combine_fc1_weights_kernel(
    hidden,
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
):
    block_i = 64
    block_h = 256
    threads = 256

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate, hidden), T.float16),
        up_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate, hidden), T.float16),
        combined_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate * 2, hidden), T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate * 2, block_i),
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_h),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bi, bh):
            for i, j in T.Parallel(block_i, block_h):
                row = bi * block_i + i
                col = bh * block_h + j
                if row < intermediate:
                    combined_w[expert_id, row, col] = gate_w[expert_id, row, col]
                else:
                    combined_w[expert_id, row, col] = up_w[
                        expert_id, row - intermediate, col
                    ]

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _combined_swiglu_kernel(
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    expert_block_m,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    combined_shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate * 2)
    activation_shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_up_output: T.Tensor(combined_shape, T.float16),
        activation: T.Tensor(activation_shape, T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                gate = gate_up_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                    gate
                    * T.sigmoid(gate)
                    * gate_up_output[
                        expert_id,
                        i,
                        intermediate + bn * block_n + j,
                    ]
                )

    return kernel


def _get_kernels(
    hidden,
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    total_padded_tokens,
    total_valid_tokens,
    expert_block_m,
):
    key = (
        int(hidden),
        int(intermediate),
        int(num_experts),
        int(total_padded_tokens),
        int(total_valid_tokens),
        int(expert_block_m),
    )
    kernels = _KERNEL_CACHE.get(key)
    if kernels is None:
        expert_chunk = 32 if num_experts == 32 else 16
        fuse_fc1 = False
        kernels = (
            _pack_experts_kernel(
                hidden,
                num_experts,
                total_padded_tokens,
                expert_block_m,
            ),
            _swiglu_kernel(
                intermediate,
                num_experts,
                expert_block_m,
            ),
            (
                _combine_fc1_weights_kernel(hidden, intermediate, num_experts)
                if fuse_fc1
                else None
            ),
            (
                _combined_swiglu_kernel(
                    intermediate,
                    num_experts,
                    expert_block_m,
                )
                if fuse_fc1
                else None
            ),
            tuple(
                _unpack_experts_kernel(
                    hidden,
                    num_experts,
                    total_padded_tokens,
                    total_valid_tokens,
                    expert_block_m,
                    expert_start,
                    min(expert_chunk, num_experts - expert_start),
                )
                for expert_start in range(0, num_experts, expert_chunk)
            ),
        )
        _KERNEL_CACHE[key] = kernels
    return kernels


def _get_workspace(
    stacked_expert_tokens,
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    expert_block_m,
):
    global _WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY, _WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE
    hidden = int(stacked_expert_tokens.shape[1])
    key = (
        int(stacked_expert_tokens.device.index or 0),
        int(num_experts),
        hidden,
        int(intermediate),
        int(expert_block_m),
        str(stacked_expert_tokens.dtype),
    )
    if _WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY != key:
        _WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY = None
        _WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE = None
        packed_input = torch.empty(
            (num_experts, expert_block_m, hidden),
            device=stacked_expert_tokens.device,
            dtype=stacked_expert_tokens.dtype,
        )
        activation = (
            torch.empty(
                (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate),
                device=stacked_expert_tokens.device,
                dtype=stacked_expert_tokens.dtype,
            )
            if False
            else None
        )
        _WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY = key
        _WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE = (packed_input, activation)
    return _WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE


def _get_combined_fc1_weight(gate_w, up_w, combine_weights):
    key = (
        int(gate_w.device.index or 0),
        int(gate_w.shape[0]),
        int(gate_w.shape[1]),
        int(gate_w.shape[2]),
        str(gate_w.dtype),
    )
    cached = _WEIGHT_CACHE.get(key)
    if cached is None or cached[0] is not gate_w or cached[1] is not up_w:
        combined_w = torch.empty(
            (gate_w.shape[0], gate_w.shape[1] * 2, gate_w.shape[2]),
            device=gate_w.device,
            dtype=gate_w.dtype,
        )
        combine_weights(gate_w, up_w, combined_w)
        cached = (gate_w, up_w, combined_w)
        _WEIGHT_CACHE[key] = cached
    return cached[2]


def run_kernel(
    stacked_expert_tokens,
    gate_w,
    up_w,
    down_w,
    routed_expert_weights,
    group_sizes,
    group_offsets,
    group_padded_offsets,
    group_idx_for_bx,
    out,
):
    hidden = int(stacked_expert_tokens.shape[1])
    intermediate = int(gate_w.shape[1])
    num_experts = int(gate_w.shape[0])
    total_padded_tokens = int(stacked_expert_tokens.shape[0])
    total_valid_tokens = int(routed_expert_weights.shape[0])

    expert_block_m = _EXPERT_BLOCK_M

    pack, swiglu, combine_weights, combined_swiglu, unpack_chunks = _get_kernels(
        hidden,
        intermediate,
        num_experts,
        total_padded_tokens,
        total_valid_tokens,
        expert_block_m,
    )
    packed_input, activation = _get_workspace(
        stacked_expert_tokens,
        intermediate,
        num_experts,
        expert_block_m,
    )

    pack(
        stacked_expert_tokens,
        group_sizes,
        group_padded_offsets,
        packed_input,
    )
    gate_output = packed_input @ gate_w.transpose(1, 2)
    up_output = packed_input @ up_w.transpose(1, 2)
    swiglu(gate_output, up_output, group_offsets, gate_output)
    del up_output
    activation = gate_output
    expert_chunk = 32 if num_experts == 32 else 16
    for chunk_id, expert_start in enumerate(range(0, num_experts, expert_chunk)):
        expert_end = min(expert_start + expert_chunk, num_experts)
        packed_output = (
            activation[expert_start:expert_end]
            @ down_w[expert_start:expert_end].transpose(1, 2)
        )
        unpack_chunks[chunk_id](
            packed_output,
            routed_expert_weights,
            group_sizes,
            group_offsets,
            group_padded_offsets,
            out,
        )
        del packed_output

**EVIDENCE**

- Initial v140: unbound gate produced WA.
- Corrected v140 with parallel output store: still WA, small error.
- Serialized output store submission `105747`: still WA, now large error `0.1226`.
- Same serialized version was catastrophically slow on case1: `54.572ms` versus `11.275ms` baseline.
- Repeated `C500` one-shot passed, so the failure is not a simple universal arithmetic bug.

**CORRECTNESS_CLASSIFICATION**

OJ-unstable, not merely locally flaky.

The transition from unbound gate WA to small-error WA to large-error WA after serialization strongly suggests the architecture has deeper correctness fragility than just an output-store race. Passing repeated `C500` one-shot is insufficient evidence because the OJ failures show case sensitivity, ordering sensitivity, shape sensitivity, or hidden input sensitivity.

**PERFORMANCE_CLASSIFICATION**

Structurally noncompetitive.

`54.572ms` versus `11.275ms` on case1 is not a tuning gap. It is roughly `4.8x` slower than baseline. That points to the custom dense FC1 path being fundamentally inefficient for the contest workload, likely due to poor memory movement, poor occupancy, bad expert/token locality, excessive serialization, or doing dense-style work where the baseline avoids it.

**FAMILY_STATUS**

Abandon this exact v140 custom FC1 + SwiGLU kernel family.

The evidence says this family is both correctness-unstable and performance-regressive. Continuing to debug within the same design is unlikely to converge fast enough because the fixes already moved the behavior from one WA mode to another while worsening or exposing catastrophic runtime.

**BASELINE_DECISION**

Return to v136 as the baseline of record.

Do not carry forward the v140 custom dense FC1 kernel. Treat v140 as an invalid branch unless a later experiment can independently prove both correctness and speed on hidden-like cases.

**NEXT_ARCHITECTURE**

Use a materially different architecture from v136, not an incremental repair of v140:

- Keep v136é—ç‚½å„²é›?proven output/writeback and routing semantics.
- Replace the custom dense FC1 kernel with a safer expert-batched or grouped GEMM-style FC1 path.
- Fuse only where correctness is easy to preserve: bias/SwiGLU/activation after a trusted matmul primitive, rather than hand-rolling the dense FC1 accumulation and store path together.
- Optimize around token grouping, expert locality, and reuse of known-good GEMM behavior instead of bespoke per-token dense FC1 code.
- Add a hidden-case-oriented validation matrix before submission: varied token counts, expert imbalance, small/large batches, boundary expert IDs, repeated routes, and numerically sensitive inputs.

**FINAL_VERDICT**

Abandon v140é—ç‚½å„²é›?exact custom FC1 + SwiGLU kernel/family. The likely systemic issue is that the custom dense FC1 kernel is both vastly slower than baseline and OJ-unstable under hidden cases. import torch
import tilelang
import tilelang.language as T


_KERNEL_CACHE = {}
_WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY = None
_WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE = None
_WEIGHT_CACHE = {}
_EXPERT_BLOCK_M = 192


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _pack_experts_kernel(
    hidden,
    num_experts,
    total_padded_tokens,
    expert_block_m,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    packed_shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, hidden)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        stacked_expert_tokens: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        packed_input: T.Tensor(packed_shape, T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
            padded_start = group_padded_offsets[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    packed_input[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        stacked_expert_tokens[padded_start + i, bn * block_n + j]
                    )

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _unpack_experts_kernel(
    hidden,
    num_experts,
    total_padded_tokens,
    total_valid_tokens,
    expert_block_m,
    expert_start,
    expert_chunk,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    packed_shape = (expert_chunk, expert_block_m, hidden)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        packed_output: T.Tensor(packed_shape, T.float16),
        routed_expert_weights: T.Tensor((total_valid_tokens,), T.float32),
        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        out: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            expert_chunk,
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (local_expert_id, bn):
            expert_id = expert_start + local_expert_id
            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
            raw_start = group_offsets[expert_id]
            padded_start = group_padded_offsets[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    out[padded_start + i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        packed_output[local_expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                        * routed_expert_weights[raw_start + i]
                    )

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _swiglu_kernel(
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    expert_block_m,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_output: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
        up_output: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        activation: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            group_size = group_offsets[expert_id + 1] - group_offsets[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    gate = gate_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        gate
                        * T.sigmoid(gate)
                        * up_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    )

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _combine_fc1_weights_kernel(
    hidden,
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
):
    block_i = 64
    block_h = 256
    threads = 256

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate, hidden), T.float16),
        up_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate, hidden), T.float16),
        combined_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate * 2, hidden), T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate * 2, block_i),
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_h),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bi, bh):
            for i, j in T.Parallel(block_i, block_h):
                row = bi * block_i + i
                col = bh * block_h + j
                if row < intermediate:
                    combined_w[expert_id, row, col] = gate_w[expert_id, row, col]
                else:
                    combined_w[expert_id, row, col] = up_w[
                        expert_id, row - intermediate, col
                    ]

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _combined_swiglu_kernel(
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    expert_block_m,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    combined_shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate * 2)
    activation_shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_up_output: T.Tensor(combined_shape, T.float16),
        activation: T.Tensor(activation_shape, T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                gate = gate_up_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                    gate
                    * T.sigmoid(gate)
                    * gate_up_output[
                        expert_id,
                        i,
                        intermediate + bn * block_n + j,
                    ]
                )

    return kernel

        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            group_size = group_offsets[expert_id + 1] - group_offsets[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    gate = gate_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        gate
                        * T.sigmoid(gate)
                        * up_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    )

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _combine_fc1_weights_kernel(
    hidden,
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
):
    block_i = 64
    block_h = 256
    threads = 256

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate, hidden), T.float16),
        up_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate, hidden), T.float16),
        combined_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate * 2, hidden), T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate * 2, block_i),
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_h),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bi, bh):
            for i, j in T.Parallel(block_i, block_h):
                row = bi * block_i + i
                col = bh * block_h + j
                if row < intermediate:
                    combined_w[expert_id, row, col] = gate_w[expert_id, row, col]
                else:
                    combined_w[expert_id, row, col] = up_w[
                        expert_id, row - intermediate, col
                    ]

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _combined_swiglu_kernel(
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    expert_block_m,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    combined_shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate * 2)
    activation_shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_up_output: T.Tensor(combined_shape, T.float16),
        activation: T.Tensor(activation_shape, T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                gate = gate_up_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                    gate
                    * T.sigmoid(gate)
                    * gate_up_output[
                        expert_id,
                        i,
                        intermediate + bn * block_n + j,
                    ]
                )

    return kernel


def _get_kernels(
    hidden,
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    total_padded_tokens,
    total_valid_tokens,
    expert_block_m,
):
    key = (
        int(hidden),
        int(intermediate),
        int(num_experts),
        int(total_padded_tokens),
        int(total_valid_tokens),
        int(expert_block_m),
    )
    kernels = _KERNEL_CACHE.get(key)
    if kernels is None:
        expert_chunk = 32 if num_experts == 32 else 16
        fuse_fc1 = False
        kernels = (
            _pack_experts_kernel(
                hidden,
                num_experts,
                total_padded_tokens,
                expert_block_m,
            ),
            _swiglu_kernel(
                intermediate,
                num_experts,
                expert_block_m,
            ),
            (
                _combine_fc1_weights_kernel(hidden, intermediate, num_experts)
                if fuse_fc1
                else None
            ),
            (
                _combined_swiglu_kernel(
                    intermediate,
                    num_experts,
                    expert_block_m,
                )
                if fuse_fc1
                else None
            ),
            tuple(
                _unpack_experts_kernel(
                    hidden,
                    num_experts,
                    total_padded_tokens,
                    total_valid_tokens,
                    expert_block_m,
                    expert_start,
                    min(expert_chunk, num_experts - expert_start),
                )
                for expert_start in range(0, num_experts, expert_chunk)
            ),
        )
        _KERNEL_CACHE[key] = kernels
    return kernels


def _get_workspace(
    stacked_expert_tokens,
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    expert_block_m,
):
    global _WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY, _WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE
    hidden = int(stacked_expert_tokens.shape[1])
    key = (
        int(stacked_expert_tokens.device.index or 0),
        int(num_experts),
        hidden,
        int(intermediate),
        int(expert_block_m),
        str(stacked_expert_tokens.dtype),
    )
    if _WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY != key:
        _WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY = None
        _WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE = None
        packed_input = torch.empty(
            (num_experts, expert_block_m, hidden),
            device=stacked_expert_tokens.device,
            dtype=stacked_expert_tokens.dtype,
        )
        activation = (
            torch.empty(
                (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate),
                device=stacked_expert_tokens.device,
                dtype=stacked_expert_tokens.dtype,
            )
            if False
            else None
        )
        _WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY = key
        _WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE = (packed_input, activation)
    return _WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE


def _get_combined_fc1_weight(gate_w, up_w, combine_weights):
    key = (
        int(gate_w.device.index or 0),
        int(gate_w.shape[0]),
        int(gate_w.shape[1]),
        int(gate_w.shape[2]),
        str(gate_w.dtype),
    )
    cached = _WEIGHT_CACHE.get(key)
    if cached is None or cached[0] is not gate_w or cached[1] is not up_w:
        combined_w = torch.empty(
            (gate_w.shape[0], gate_w.shape[1] * 2, gate_w.shape[2]),
            device=gate_w.device,
            dtype=gate_w.dtype,
        )
        combine_weights(gate_w, up_w, combined_w)
        cached = (gate_w, up_w, combined_w)
        _WEIGHT_CACHE[key] = cached
    return cached[2]


def run_kernel(
    stacked_expert_tokens,
    gate_w,
    up_w,
    down_w,
    routed_expert_weights,
    group_sizes,
    group_offsets,
    group_padded_offsets,
    group_idx_for_bx,
    out,
):
    hidden = int(stacked_expert_tokens.shape[1])
    intermediate = int(gate_w.shape[1])
    num_experts = int(gate_w.shape[0])
    total_padded_tokens = int(stacked_expert_tokens.shape[0])
    total_valid_tokens = int(routed_expert_weights.shape[0])

    expert_block_m = _EXPERT_BLOCK_M

    pack, swiglu, combine_weights, combined_swiglu, unpack_chunks = _get_kernels(
        hidden,
        intermediate,
        num_experts,
        total_padded_tokens,
        total_valid_tokens,
        expert_block_m,
    )
    packed_input, activation = _get_workspace(
        stacked_expert_tokens,
        intermediate,
        num_experts,
        expert_block_m,
    )

    pack(
        stacked_expert_tokens,
        group_sizes,
        group_padded_offsets,
        packed_input,
    )
    gate_output = packed_input @ gate_w.transpose(1, 2)
    up_output = packed_input @ up_w.transpose(1, 2)
    swiglu(gate_output, up_output, group_offsets, gate_output)
    activation = gate_output
    expert_chunk = 32 if num_experts == 32 else 16
    for chunk_id, expert_start in enumerate(range(0, num_experts, expert_chunk)):
        expert_end = min(expert_start + expert_chunk, num_experts)
        packed_output = (
            activation[expert_start:expert_end]
            @ down_w[expert_start:expert_end].transpose(1, 2)
        )
        unpack_chunks[chunk_id](
            packed_output,
            routed_expert_weights,
            group_sizes,
            group_offsets,
            group_padded_offsets,
            out,
        )

codex
FAMILY_RANKING

1. **E16 up-FC1 feature streaming, FC2 unchanged**  
   Keep standard high-level GEMM for `gate_output`; compute only `up_output` in feature chunks; apply chunked SwiGLU into `gate_output`; then run v136 FC2 unchanged. Best candidate: materially different memory-lifetime change, no custom dense FC1, no retained memory increase.

2. **FC1+FC2 feature streaming with partial FC2 accumulation**  
   Compute activation chunks and immediately GEMM them into partial FC2 outputs. Larger memory upside, but needs accumulation across K chunks, likely fp32/ordering-sensitive, and would require custom add/reduction semantics. Too risky.

3. **Shape-specific standard GEMM expert sub-batching**  
   Split FC1 by expert groups while keeping high-level BMM. This overlaps with v116/v122-style chunking and adds launches without clear memory or compute reduction. Low novelty and low expected gain.

DUPLICATE_AUDIT

Selected candidate is not v140 custom dense FC1+SwiGLU. It keeps `@`/standard high-level GEMM-backed FC1.

It is also not:
- plain FC2 expert chunk enumeration,
- elementwise wider block probing,
- combined `[gate; up]` retained weight,
- dynamic M176/M160,
- preallocated `torch.bmm(..., out=...)`,
- external prepare/cache trick,
- local transpose hoist.

SELECTED_ARCHITECTURE

Implement `v141_e16_stream_up_fc1_chunks.py` from v136.

Only change case1 shape: `num_experts == 16`, `hidden == 2048`, `intermediate == 8192`.

Dataflow:
```python
gate_output = packed_input @ gate_w.transpose(1, 2)

for feature chunk f0:f1, size 2048:
    up_chunk = packed_input @ up_w[:, f0:f1, :].transpose(1, 2)
    swiglu_feature_chunk(gate_output, up_chunk, group_offsets, gate_output)

activation = gate_output
# existing v136 FC2 chunk/unpack path unchanged
```

For E32/E64, leave v136 exactly unchanged.

NUMBERED_MODIFICATION_POINTS

1. Copy v136 to `v141_e16_stream_up_fc1_chunks.py`.
2. Add `_swiglu_feature_chunk_kernel(intermediate, feature_start, feature_chunk, num_experts, expert_block_m)`.
3. Kernel reads full `gate_output[..., feature_start + local_j]`, reads `up_chunk[..., local_j]`, writes activation back into `gate_output[..., feature_start + local_j]`.
4. Add tuple of four chunk kernels for E16 case1: starts `0, 2048, 4096, 6144`.
5. In `run_kernel`, branch only for `num_experts == 16 and hidden == 2048 and intermediate == 8192`.
6. Compute full `gate_output` once using standard `@`.
7. Compute `up_chunk` with standard sliced high-level `@`; do not use `torch.bmm`.
8. Reuse v136 FC2 and unpack exactly.

DATAFLOW_PROOF

SwiGLU is feature-independent:
`activation[e, m, k] = silu(gate[e, m, k]) * up[e, m, k]`.

Splitting `up` by feature columns does not alter dependencies. After all four chunks, `gate_output` contains the full activation tensor with the same shape and indexing v136 passes to FC2.

FC2 sees identical logical input:
`activation @ down_w.transpose(1, 2)`.

MEMORY_LIFETIME_PROOF

v136 case1 peak retains:
- `packed_input`,
- full `gate_output`,
- full `up_output`,
- FC2 temporary.

v141 case1 retains:
- `packed_input`,
- full `gate_output`,
- one `up_chunk`,
- FC2 temporary after up chunks are done.

No cross-case retained memory increase. E32/E64 unchanged. No cached combined weight. Kernel cache grows only by four small compiled kernels, not tensor memory.

EXPECTED_GAIN

Expected gain is shallow: likely `0%` to `1%`, mainly from lower peak allocation pressure and shorter `up_output` lifetime. It may regress if four smaller GEMMs lose more launch/GEMM efficiency than the allocator/memory benefit recovers.

Credible chance exists because case1 has large `intermediate=8192`; chunk size `2048` still leaves a substantial GEMM N dimension.

CORRECTNESS_RISKS

- Sliced high-level matmul must be accepted by sandbox via `@`.
- Feature chunk indexing must cover exactly `[0, 8192)`.
- In-place write to `gate_output` is safe only after the corresponding gate values are read for that feature chunk.
- Padding guard must match v136é–³ãƒ¦ç¨ `group_offsets` behavior.

PERFORMANCE_RISKS

- Four up-GEMM launches replace one up-GEMM launch.
- Smaller N may reduce GEMM efficiency.
- Extra SwiGLU launches replace one full SwiGLU launch.
- If allocator pressure is already hidden by runtime caching, timing may regress.

IMPLEMENTATION_INSTRUCTIONS

Use chunk size `2048`. Do not touch E32/E64.

Do not use `torch.bmm`, `out=`, retained combined weights, or custom FC1 accumulation. Keep all FC2 code byte-for-byte equivalent except variable names needed for the branch.

C500_GATE

Run all three correctness cases. Require exact pass. Then run repeat stability for case1 because this branch changes temporary lifetime.

XPUOJ_GATE

Submit only if local C500 passes all cases and case1 is not locally slower. Accept XPUOJ only if all three cases pass and case1 improves or is neutral within noise; reject on any E32/E64 drift because those paths should be unchanged.

+def _bucket_compact_kernel(
+    intermediate,
+    num_experts,
+    expert_block_m,
+    bucket_m,
+):
+    block_n = 256
+    threads = 256
+
+    @T.prim_func
+    def kernel(
+        activation: T.Tensor(
+            (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate), T.float16
+        ),
+        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
+        bucket_activation: T.Tensor(
+            (num_experts, bucket_m, intermediate), T.float16
+        ),
+    ):
+        with T.Kernel(
+            num_experts,
+            T.ceildiv(intermediate, block_n),
+            threads=threads,
+        ) as (expert_id, bn):
+            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
+            for i, j in T.Parallel(bucket_m, block_n):
+                if i < group_size:
+                    bucket_activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
+                        activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
+                    )
+                else:
+                    bucket_activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = T.float16(0)
+
+    return kernel
+

+        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),

+    ):
+        with T.Kernel(
+            num_experts,

+            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
+            raw_start = group_offsets[expert_id]

+                        * routed_expert_weights[raw_start + i]
+                    )
+
+    return kernel

Standard high-level FC1/FC2 GEMMs preferred. Existing packed activation shape [E,192,I], group_sizes/offsets on device, pack/unpack TileLang kernels. Saturated/blocked families in optimization_log.
Explore device-side compaction from [E,192,I] to a small number of bucketed batched buffers with fixed M buckets, then batched FC2 and fused/direct unpack, or a case-specific vectorized route. Since group sizes vary, provide an exact mechanism implementable using TileLang metadata kernels plus a bounded number of high-level batched matmuls, with no host scalar extraction. Rank three architectures, choose one bounded prototype (one fixed case is allowed), and give code-level instructions. Retained cross-case memory must not increase beyond single-entry workspace semantics.

codex
FAMILY_RANKING

1. Bucketed exact-row FC2 with device metadata, selected  
   Compact only active FC2 rows from existing `[E,192,I]` activation into bucketed dense buffers, run a bounded number of high-level grouped/batched FC2 GEMMs, then scatter directly to output. This keeps FC1/activation path intact, avoids `.item`, avoids per-expert matmul loops, and replaces sparse padded FC2 work with a small fixed launch count.

2. Case-specific vectorized direct FC2 for small active sets  
   Use TileLang kernels to compute FC2 directly from `[E,192,I]` for experts whose `group_size <= threshold`, while large experts use standard GEMM. This can reduce wasted FC2 work, but risks rebuilding matmul logic and may underperform vendor GEMM.

3. Single global compacted FC2 buffer with expert-block GEMM loop inside one custom kernel  
   Device-side flatten all active rows into `[N_active,I]`, then custom expert-aware FC2. This has clean memory behavior but violates the preference for standard high-level GEMMs and is higher correctness/performance risk.

DUPLICATE_AUDIT

This is not v142 host-sync exact-row FC2. The selected design does not read group sizes to host, does not call `.item`, does not build Python-side per-expert shapes, and does not loop over experts issuing many matmuls. It uses fixed bucket capacities and fixed launch structure known at compile/runtime from the case configuration.

SELECTED_ARCHITECTURE

v143: device-side bucketed exact-row FC2.

Use existing packed activation:

```text
act_packed: [E, 192, I]
group_sizes: [E] device int32
group_offsets: [E] device int32 or equivalent routing offsets
```

Add a TileLang metadata kernel that assigns each expert to one of a small number of fixed-M buckets based on `group_size`. Then compact active rows into dense bucket buffers:

```text
bucket0: [B0, M0, I]
bucket1: [B1, M1, I]
...
```

where `M0/M1/...` are fixed capacities, for example:

```text
M_BUCKETS = [16, 32, 64, 128, 192]
```

Each expert with `0 < group_size <= M` goes into the smallest matching bucket. FC2 runs as bounded batched matmuls per bucket, not per expert.

NUMBERED_MODIFICATION_POINTS

1. Add v143 entry point cloned from v141, preserving v141 FC1, gating, activation, pack, and unpack behavior.

2. Add temporary workspace tensors scoped to one invocation only:
   ```text
   bucket_counts: [NB] int32
   bucket_expert_ids: [NB, E] int32
   bucket_row_counts: [NB, E] int32
   bucket_dst_offsets: [NB, E] int32
   bucket_act: max over bucket storage, reused per bucket or single-entry workspace
   bucket_out: corresponding FC2 output workspace
   ```

3. Add TileLang metadata kernel:
   - input: `group_sizes[E]`
   - output: bucket assignment metadata
   - uses device atomics to append expert ids into bucket lists
   - no host reads

4. Add TileLang compact kernel:
   - input: `act_packed[E,192,I]`, metadata
   - output: `bucket_act[sum_bucket_experts, M_bucket, I]`
   - copies only `row < group_size`
   - zeros or ignores rows `row >= group_size`

5. Run high-level batched FC2 per bucket:
   ```text
   bucket_out[b, m, O] = bucket_act[b, m, I] @ W2[expert_id[b], I, O]
   ```
   using grouped/batched matmul where batch dimension indexes experts.

6. Add TileLang scatter/unpack kernel:
   - input: `bucket_out`, metadata, original token routing/group offsets
   - writes exact active rows back to final output positions
   - ignores padded bucket rows

7. Keep all new buffers local to the v143 call path and reuse a single workspace entry. Do not retain cross-case buffers larger than v141é–³ãƒ¦ç¨ single-entry workspace model.

DEVICE_METADATA_FLOW

```text
group_sizes[E]
   |
   | metadata_assign_kernel
   v
bucket_counts[NB]
bucket_expert_ids[NB,E]
bucket_row_counts[NB,E]
bucket_dst_offsets[NB,E]
   |
   | compact_bucket_kernel
   v
bucket_act[batch_bucket, M_bucket, I]
   |
   | bounded batched FC2 GEMM
   v
bucket_out[batch_bucket, M_bucket, O]
   |
   | scatter_bucket_kernel
   v
final output
```

The host only launches kernels and GEMMs for the fixed bucket list. It never extracts dynamic scalar sizes.

BATCHED_GEMM_PLAN

Use fixed bucket capacities:

```text
NB = 5
M_BUCKETS = [16, 32, 64, 128, 192]
```

For each bucket capacity `M`, launch at most one batched/grouped FC2 operation:

```python
# Pseudocode only. No .item(), no expert loop.
for bucket_id, M in enumerate(M_BUCKETS):
    # Fixed launch per bucket, not per expert.
    # Batch count is represented by device metadata or fixed E upper bound.
    # Inactive bucket slots have zero rows and are ignored on scatter.
    bucket_act_M = workspace.act[bucket_id]      # [E, M, I] or compacted [max_bucket_E, M, I]
    expert_ids_M = metadata.bucket_expert_ids[bucket_id]

    bucket_out_M = grouped_batched_matmul(
        A=bucket_act_M,                          # [Bmax, M, I]
        B=W2.indexed_by(expert_ids_M),           # [Bmax, I, O]
        active_mask=bucket_row_counts[bucket_id] # device metadata
    )
```

If the available high-level API cannot accept device-indexed weights directly, use a TileLang gather-weight-view/copy kernel into a per-bucket contiguous weight buffer:

```text
bucket_w2: [Bmax, I, O]
```

Then call ordinary batched matmul:

```text
[Bmax, M, I] x [Bmax, I, O] -> [Bmax, M, O]
```

This is still bounded: at most `NB` weight-gather kernels, `NB` compact kernels, `NB` batched GEMMs, and `NB` scatter kernels. No expert-count launch scaling.

OUTPUT_MAPPING_PROOF

For each expert `e`, v141 computes FC2 for rows:

```text
r in [0, group_sizes[e])
act_packed[e, r, :]
```

v143 assigns expert `e` to exactly one bucket `b` where:

```text
M_BUCKETS[b-1] < group_sizes[e] <= M_BUCKETS[b]
```

or the first bucket if `group_sizes[e] <= 16`.

The compact kernel writes:

```text
bucket_act[b, slot(e), r, :] = act_packed[e, r, :]
```

for exactly the same active row domain:

```text
0 <= r < group_sizes[e]
```

The batched FC2 computes:

```text
bucket_out[b, slot(e), r, :] =
    bucket_act[b, slot(e), r, :] @ W2[e]
```

The scatter kernel writes:

```text
final[token_index(e,r), :] = bucket_out[b, slot(e), r, :]
```

using the same group offsets/routing metadata as v141 unpack. Padded rows `r >= group_sizes[e]` are never scattered, so they cannot affect correctness.

MEMORY_LIFETIME_PROOF

Retained cross-case memory does not increase.

All added tensors are per-call workspace aliases or single-entry scratch:

```text
metadata scratch
bucket_act scratch
bucket_w2 scratch, only if required
bucket_out scratch
```

They can reuse the same workspace slot across cases because bucket capacities are fixed by the selected compiled variant. No persistent cache keyed by case, shape, or expert distribution is introduced.

The peak temporary size is bounded by one v143 workspace entry, not accumulated across invocations.

EXPECTED_GAIN

Expected gain comes from removing padded FC2 work for experts with small `group_size`.

v141 FC2 effectively pays close to:

```text
E * 192 * I * O
```

v143 pays approximately:

```text
sum_e bucket_ceil(group_sizes[e]) * I * O
```

plus compact/scatter overhead.

Best case: many experts have small groups, saving 25-60% of FC2 arithmetic.  
Worst case: most experts are near 192 rows, savings are small and overhead can regress.

Expected benchmark target: improve worst/median on cases with skewed routing while preserving v141-style behavior on dense cases.

CORRECTNESS_RISKS

1. Bucket assignment off-by-one at exact boundaries `16/32/64/128/192`.

2. Scatter must use original token/order metadata, not compacted bucket slot order.

3. Padded bucket rows must be ignored, not written.

4. Weight indexing must match expert id exactly.

5. If activation includes gating/scaling before FC2, compact after that point; if scaling is after FC2 in v141, preserve that ordering.

PERFORMANCE_RISKS

1. Compact plus scatter overhead may dominate when group sizes are dense.

2. Weight gather into `bucket_w2` can be expensive if `I*O` is large and repeated for many buckets.

3. Five batched GEMMs may still be slower than one padded GEMM for small `E`.

4. Batched GEMM may underutilize hardware for tiny bucket populations.

5. Atomic bucket assignment overhead is small but nonzero.

IMPLEMENTATION_INSTRUCTIONS

1. Create `v143` by copying v141 implementation, not v142.

2. Keep existing FC1 and activation path unchanged until `[E,192,I]`.

3. Add constants:
   ```python
   M_BUCKETS = (16, 32, 64, 128, 192)
   NB = 5
   ```

4. Add metadata TileLang kernel:
   ```text
   for expert e:
       n = group_sizes[e]
       if n == 0: skip or put in count-zero sentinel
       b = first bucket where n <= M_BUCKETS[b]
       slot = atomic_add(bucket_counts[b], 1)
       bucket_expert_ids[b, slot] = e
       bucket_row_counts[b, slot] = n
   ```

5. Add compact TileLang kernel per fixed bucket:
   ```text
   for slot, row, col:
       e = bucket_expert_ids[bucket, slot]
       n = bucket_row_counts[bucket, slot]
       if row < n:
           bucket_act[slot,row,col] = act_packed[e,row,col]
       else:
           bucket_act[slot,row,col] = 0
   ```

6. Prefer high-level grouped/batched FC2:
   ```text
   bucket_act[slot,M,I] x W2[expert_id(slot),I,O]
   ```

7. If direct indexed grouped GEMM is unavailable, add bounded weight gather:
   ```text
   bucket_w2[slot,i,o] = W2[expert_id(slot),i,o]
   ```
   then use ordinary batched matmul.

8. Add scatter TileLang kernel:
   ```text
   for slot, row, o:
       n = bucket_row_counts[bucket, slot]
       if row < n:
           e = bucket_expert_ids[bucket, slot]
           dst = original_group_offsets[e] + row
           write final using existing v141 unpack mapping
   ```

9. Add a dense fallback gate:
   ```text
   if selected fixed case is known dense, use v141 FC2 path
   ```
   This gate must be based on compile-time case id or device-side metadata path, not `.item()`.

10. Benchmark only v143 versus v141 and v142-blocked notes. Do not inspect `xpuoj/` or old `fused_moe_gemm/`.

import torch
import tilelang
import tilelang.language as T


_KERNEL_CACHE = {}
_WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY = None
_WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE = None
_WEIGHT_CACHE = {}
_EXPERT_BLOCK_M = 192


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _pack_experts_kernel(
    hidden,
    num_experts,
    total_padded_tokens,
    expert_block_m,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    packed_shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, hidden)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        stacked_expert_tokens: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        packed_input: T.Tensor(packed_shape, T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
            padded_start = group_padded_offsets[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    packed_input[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        stacked_expert_tokens[padded_start + i, bn * block_n + j]
                    )

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _unpack_experts_kernel(
    hidden,
    num_experts,
    total_padded_tokens,
    total_valid_tokens,
    expert_block_m,
    expert_start,
    expert_chunk,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    packed_shape = (expert_chunk, expert_block_m, hidden)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        packed_output: T.Tensor(packed_shape, T.float16),
        routed_expert_weights: T.Tensor((total_valid_tokens,), T.float32),
        group_sizes: T.Tensor((num_experts,), T.int32),
        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        group_padded_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        out: T.Tensor((total_padded_tokens, hidden), T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            expert_chunk,
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (local_expert_id, bn):
            expert_id = expert_start + local_expert_id
            group_size = group_sizes[expert_id]
            raw_start = group_offsets[expert_id]
            padded_start = group_padded_offsets[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    out[padded_start + i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        packed_output[local_expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                        * routed_expert_weights[raw_start + i]
                    )

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _swiglu_kernel(
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    expert_block_m,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_output: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
        up_output: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
        group_offsets: T.Tensor((num_experts + 1,), T.int32),
        activation: T.Tensor(shape, T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            group_size = group_offsets[expert_id + 1] - group_offsets[expert_id]
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                if i < group_size:
                    gate = gate_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                        gate
                        * T.sigmoid(gate)
                        * up_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                    )

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _combine_fc1_weights_kernel(
    hidden,
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
):
    block_i = 64
    block_h = 256
    threads = 256

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate, hidden), T.float16),
        up_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate, hidden), T.float16),
        combined_w: T.Tensor((num_experts, intermediate * 2, hidden), T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate * 2, block_i),
            T.ceildiv(hidden, block_h),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bi, bh):
            for i, j in T.Parallel(block_i, block_h):
                row = bi * block_i + i
                col = bh * block_h + j
                if row < intermediate:
                    combined_w[expert_id, row, col] = gate_w[expert_id, row, col]
                else:
                    combined_w[expert_id, row, col] = up_w[
                        expert_id, row - intermediate, col
                    ]

    return kernel


@tilelang.jit(
    pass_configs={
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_WARP_SPECIALIZED: True,
        tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_SAFE_MEMORY_ACCESS: True,
    }
)
def _combined_swiglu_kernel(
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    expert_block_m,
):
    block_n = 256
    threads = 256
    combined_shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate * 2)
    activation_shape = (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate)

    @T.prim_func
    def kernel(
        gate_up_output: T.Tensor(combined_shape, T.float16),
        activation: T.Tensor(activation_shape, T.float16),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(
            num_experts,
            T.ceildiv(intermediate, block_n),
            threads=threads,
        ) as (expert_id, bn):
            for i, j in T.Parallel(expert_block_m, block_n):
                gate = gate_up_output[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j]
                activation[expert_id, i, bn * block_n + j] = (
                    gate
                    * T.sigmoid(gate)
                    * gate_up_output[
                        expert_id,
                        i,
                        intermediate + bn * block_n + j,
                    ]
                )

    return kernel


def _get_kernels(
    hidden,
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    total_padded_tokens,
    total_valid_tokens,
    expert_block_m,
):
    key = (
        int(hidden),
        int(intermediate),
        int(num_experts),
        int(total_padded_tokens),
        int(total_valid_tokens),
        int(expert_block_m),
    )
    kernels = _KERNEL_CACHE.get(key)
    if kernels is None:
        expert_chunk = 32 if num_experts == 32 else 16
        fuse_fc1 = False
        kernels = (
            _pack_experts_kernel(
                hidden,
                num_experts,
                total_padded_tokens,
                expert_block_m,
            ),
            _swiglu_kernel(
                intermediate,
                num_experts,
                expert_block_m,
            ),
            (
                _combine_fc1_weights_kernel(hidden, intermediate, num_experts)
                if fuse_fc1
                else None
            ),
            (
                _combined_swiglu_kernel(
                    intermediate,
                    num_experts,
                    expert_block_m,
                )
                if fuse_fc1
                else None
            ),
            tuple(
                _unpack_experts_kernel(
                    hidden,
                    num_experts,
                    total_padded_tokens,
                    total_valid_tokens,
                    expert_block_m,
                    expert_start,
                    min(expert_chunk, num_experts - expert_start),
                )
                for expert_start in range(0, num_experts, expert_chunk)
            ),
        )
        _KERNEL_CACHE[key] = kernels
    return kernels


def _get_workspace(
    stacked_expert_tokens,
    intermediate,
    num_experts,
    expert_block_m,
):
    global _WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY, _WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE
    hidden = int(stacked_expert_tokens.shape[1])
    key = (
        int(stacked_expert_tokens.device.index or 0),
        int(num_experts),
        hidden,
        int(intermediate),
        int(expert_block_m),
        str(stacked_expert_tokens.dtype),
    )
    if _WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY != key:
        _WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY = None
        _WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE = None
        packed_input = torch.empty(
            (num_experts, expert_block_m, hidden),
            device=stacked_expert_tokens.device,
            dtype=stacked_expert_tokens.dtype,
        )
        activation = (
            torch.empty(
                (num_experts, expert_block_m, intermediate),
                device=stacked_expert_tokens.device,
                dtype=stacked_expert_tokens.dtype,
            )
            if False
            else None
        )
        _WORKSPACE_CACHE_KEY = key
        _WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE = (packed_input, activation)
    return _WORKSPACE_CACHE_VALUE


def _get_combined_fc1_weight(gate_w, up_w, combine_weights):
    key = (
        int(gate_w.device.index or 0),
        int(gate_w.shape[0]),
        int(gate_w.shape[1]),
        int(gate_w.shape[2]),
        str(gate_w.dtype),
    )
    cached = _WEIGHT_CACHE.get(key)
    if cached is None or cached[0] is not gate_w or cached[1] is not up_w:
        combined_w = torch.empty(
            (gate_w.shape[0], gate_w.shape[1] * 2, gate_w.shape[2]),
            device=gate_w.device,
            dtype=gate_w.dtype,
        )
        combine_weights(gate_w, up_w, combined_w)
        cached = (gate_w, up_w, combined_w)
        _WEIGHT_CACHE[key] = cached
    return cached[2]


def run_kernel(
    stacked_expert_tokens,
    gate_w,
    up_w,
    down_w,
    routed_expert_weights,
    group_sizes,
    group_offsets,
    group_padded_offsets,
    group_idx_for_bx,
    out,
):
    hidden = int(stacked_expert_tokens.shape[1])
    intermediate = int(gate_w.shape[1])
    num_experts = int(gate_w.shape[0])
    total_padded_tokens = int(stacked_expert_tokens.shape[0])
    total_valid_tokens = int(routed_expert_weights.shape[0])

    expert_block_m = _EXPERT_BLOCK_M

    pack, swiglu, combine_weights, combined_swiglu, unpack_chunks = _get_kernels(
        hidden,
        intermediate,
        num_experts,
        total_padded_tokens,
        total_valid_tokens,
        expert_block_m,
    )
    packed_input, activation = _get_workspace(
        stacked_expert_tokens,
        intermediate,
        num_experts,
        expert_block_m,
    )

    pack(
        stacked_expert_tokens,
        group_sizes,
        group_padded_offsets,
        packed_input,
    )
    gate_output = packed_input @ gate_w.transpose(1, 2)
    up_output = packed_input @ up_w.transpose(1, 2)
    swiglu(gate_output, up_output, group_offsets, gate_output)
    del up_output
    activation = gate_output
    for expert_id in range(num_experts):
        group_size = int(group_sizes[expert_id].item())
        if group_size == 0:
            continue
        raw_start = int(group_offsets[expert_id].item())
        padded_start = int(group_padded_offsets[expert_id].item())
        expert_output = (
            activation[expert_id, :group_size]
            @ down_w[expert_id].transpose(0, 1)
        )
        out[padded_start : padded_start + group_size].copy_(
            expert_output
            * routed_expert_weights[raw_start : raw_start + group_size, None]
        )
        del expert_output
